caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu, a soft-boiled egg, and crisp menma. Topped with shredded cabbage and green onions, it sits in a white bowl with red trim, resting on a vibrant red surface under bright, even lighting.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, solid red surface with subtle light reflections and faint texture variations.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green vegetables.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange-red yolk surrounded by a firm white, with a slightly glossy surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red rim, smooth surface, and subtle red pattern near top edge.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
